company.name: Entrext labs
company.overview:
About Entrext Labs

Entrext Labs is the research and innovation division of Entrext, dedicated to building cutting-edge Artificial Intelligence and advanced technology solutions that empower businesses and individuals. The lab focuses on developing scalable, intelligent systems across domains such as machine learning, computer vision, natural language processing, and AI-driven automation.

At Entrext Labs, we bridge the gap between research and real-world applications by transforming innovative ideas into production-ready products. Our team of engineers, researchers, and developers works on designing high-performance AI models, intelligent platforms, and automation tools that improve efficiency, enhance decision-making, and create impactful digital experiences.

We specialize in:

Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning solutions

Computer Vision and image intelligence systems

Natural Language Processing and generative AI

AI-powered platforms and automation tools

Research-driven product development

Scalable backend and AI infrastructure

Our mission is to accelerate technological innovation by building intelligent systems that solve real-world problems and enable organizations to leverage the full potential of AI.

Entrext Labs is committed to continuous innovation, engineering excellence, and creating future-ready AI solutions that drive growth, efficiency, and digital transformation.

https://entrextlabs.entrext.com/

open_jobs.title: AI Engineer
open_jobs.description:
Job Description: AI Developer

Company: Entrext
Location: Pune, Maharashtra, India
Employment Type: Full-time
Experience Level: 1–4 Years (Entry to Mid-Level)

Position Overview

Entrext is seeking a highly motivated and skilled AI Developer to join our growing AI engineering team in Pune. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, and deploying machine learning and AI solutions that power our next-generation products. You will work closely with cross-functional teams including software engineers, data scientists, and product managers to build scalable and production-ready AI systems.

This role requires strong programming skills, a solid foundation in machine learning, and hands-on experience with modern AI frameworks.

Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, and deploy machine learning and deep learning models for real-world applications

Build and optimize AI pipelines for training, evaluation, and inference

Develop AI solutions in areas such as:

Computer Vision

Natural Language Processing (NLP)

Recommendation Systems

Predictive Analytics

Work with large datasets: preprocessing, feature engineering, and data analysis

Integrate AI models into backend systems, APIs, or production environments

Optimize models for performance, scalability, and efficiency

Collaborate with engineering teams to deploy models using cloud platforms

Research and implement latest AI techniques and best practices

Monitor and maintain deployed models
